title: Hammered's
description: Hammered's - is a mod adds a hammers (multitools), they very good but weak.
body:
# Hammered's  
**"One tool to mine them all — but at a cost."**

Hammered's introduces **multi-tool hammers** that combine the power of a pickaxe, axe, and shovel into a single item. No more swapping tools — just swing your hammer and keep digging, chopping, or shoveling with ease.  

But beware:  
- Hammers are **strong in combat** and **less durable** than regular tools.  
- Their true strength lies in **efficiency** and **versatility**.

## How it changes gameplay  
- **Compact survival:** Save precious inventory space with an all-in-one tool.  
- **Early-game boost:** Mine, dig, and chop faster without crafting every single tool.  
- **Perfect backup:** Even late-game, a hammer is a handy companion when exploring or building.
